name: zgeometry_clip_polygon_upsert_point_list_xy
description: zGeometry_ClipPolygon::UpsertPointListXY updates existing near-XY points and inserts new points that lie on existing clip-polygon edges.
known_limits: The smoke target covers update, insertion, no-op, and empty-input paths; allocation-failure behavior is not forced.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zGeometry clip-polygon source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x46ab90 validates the pointCount <= 0 no-op, per-point loop, FindPointIndexXY update path, FindPointInsertionEdgeXYIndex insert path, realloc to old count plus one, conditional memmove for non-tail insertions, point-count increment, result flag, and final return.

The native clip-polygon upsert smoke verifies replacement of an existing near-XY point, insertion into a polygon edge with shifted tail points, non-edge no-op behavior, and empty-input no-op behavior.
